rubric.weighting: Equal format weights, then equal brief weights.
rubric.materialRegression: After unblinding: overall candidate-minus-baseline mean <= -1/20; any brief <= -2/20; or the same format <= -3/20 in at least two briefs. A newly introduced material fabrication, qualification reversal, No CTA violation, or unusable required format independently fails the gate. Shared critical defects still block a clean pass.
rubric.ctaInterpretation: Practical content advice is not an engagement CTA. No CTA forbids audience engagement requests even when embedded in body text. A generic invitation to the supplied class is allowed; invented reply fulfillment or services are not.
rubric.structuralAcceptance: Separate from quality totals. Valid serialization does not establish usable content.
